profile_text.body:
Gaggle describes itself as a K-12 online safety management software company. According to its site, it provides student safety software that lets K-12 schools monitor student activity on school-provided devices for concerning content. Its Gaggle Safety Management product, as the company describes it, uses advanced machine learning and trained safety experts to analyze student-created content in school-issued accounts and devices.

The company's tracked product is also named Gaggle, listed under education and research AI. Its AI flagging is paired with human review, and the stated use is student safety monitoring of school accounts, for district administrators and counselors. It monitors school-issued accounts of enrolled students. On privacy, the product operates under a district contract, and a human safety team reviews every flagged item before escalation, per vendor and district pages. Pricing has been reported by a third party at about $7 per account per year, to be confirmed by quote. A caution noted in the research is that there is no evidence that monitoring prevents harm.
